hooks.command: HOOK="inject_system_prompt.py"; ROOT="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ ! -f "$ROOT/hooks/$HOOK" ]; then CACHE="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache"; ROOT="$(ls -dt "$CACHE"/*/meta-knowledge-graph/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; fi; if [ ! -f "$ROOT/hooks/$HOOK" ]; then echo "[mkg hooks] cannot locate $HOOK in installed Codex plugin cache" >&2; exit 0; fi; MKG_HOOK_ROOT="$ROOT" MKG_CLIENT=codex uv run --script "$ROOT/hooks/$HOOK"
